sentences.en: I must live up to my father's faith in me.
sentences.zh: 我必须不辜负父亲对我的信任。

sentences.en: To lose faith in God is to lose your guide.
sentences.zh: 失去对上帝的信任就等于失去了指引。

sentences.en: Faith makes all things possible.... love makes all things easy.
sentences.zh: 信仰让一切成为可能……爱让一切变得简单。

senses.zh: 信用，信任；宗教信仰；忠诚
